subject: Ignore lethal piercing wounds against an already-comatose PC
description: A repeated lethal arrow hit against a PC already protected by an amulet coma re-entered Rust's ordinary wound/death path, while Original RHElementActorPC::GetWounded ignores an otherwise-lethal wound in that state. ReceivePiercingDamage now preserves the PC's life and coma for that exact case while still performing AddConcussionOfTheBrain; sublethal piercing damage continues through the base-human wound implementation. Focused repeated-lethal and sublethal controls pass. The representative's original frame-714 coma/lethal mismatch clears and advances to an independent Projectile143 active-only frontier after frame 720.
